title: Game Night Fundraiser
public_description: Join us for an exciting night of video games, board games, and fun! All proceeds go to Four Diamonds Fund to help fight pediatric cancer. Entry is $10 per person.
internal_description: **Volunteer needs:** 5 volunteers for setup at 5 PM, 8 volunteers for game stations, 2 for check-in desk. Bring extension cords and game controllers from storage room.

title: Dine to Donate at Pizza Palace
public_description: Support Mini-THON by dining at Pizza Palace! Mention Mini-THON when ordering and 20% of your bill will be donated to the cause. Dine-in or takeout available from 4 PM to 9 PM.
internal_description: **Volunteer needs:** 4 volunteers to hand out flyers during lunch periods (Mon-Wed before event). 2 volunteers to be present at restaurant 7-9 PM to thank supporters.

title: Spring Walkathon
public_description: Our annual Spring Walkathon returns! Walk to raise money for Four Diamonds. Collect pledges from family and friends, then join us for a 2-mile walk around the community. Registration opens April 1st.
internal_description: **Volunteer needs:** 10 volunteers for route markers and water stations. Leadership team meeting April 15 to finalize route. Bring coolers and first aid kits. Check-in table needs 3 volunteers starting at 8 AM.

title: Mini-THON Main Event
public_description: Our biggest event of the year! A 12-hour celebration featuring games, dancing, food, and entertainment. This is what we've been working toward all year. Registration required - spots are limited!
internal_description: **Volunteer needs:** ALL MEMBERS REQUIRED. Setup crew starts Friday 6/4 at 3 PM. Day-of shifts assigned by committee chairs. Breakdown crew needed until midnight. Mandatory meeting 5/25 for final logistics.

title: Back to School Kickoff
public_description: Join Mini-THON for our Back to School Kickoff event last year! This event has already passed.
internal_description: This is a past event from 2025.
